description: THE core tool: fetch recent reviews of any iOS/Android app, keep the negative ones, and cluster them into ranked pain points (title, sharePercent, severity 1-5, verbatim evidence quotes). Ideal for competitive research and product discovery. Cached 7 days (instant on repeat); a COLD server-side analysis takes 30-120s. If the result has "mode":"agent", it contains prepared negative reviews and "instructions" — do the clustering yourself and present it to the user.

analyze.description: who clusters on a cold run: "server" = our model; "agent" = you get the prepared negative reviews + instructions and cluster them with your own model; "auto" (default) = server, switching to agent when the server-side allowance is used up

appId.description: App Store or Google Play URL, iOS numeric id (e.g. 324684580) or Android package (e.g. com.spotify.music) — get ids from search_apps

maxRating.description: ratings <= this count as negative, default 3

model.description: premium refinement model (paid keys only). Omit for the free default.

reviews.description: reviews to analyze, default 300 (other values round up to these tiers; iOS depth is ~50 due to Apple edge limits)

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (numeric id / App Store URL → ios, package / Play URL → android)

name: mine_app_pain_points
title: Mine app pain points
